case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Your offer shows how tight your seal capacity is, so our answer is built around planning security: a binding volume and a longer contract that let you plan your allocation with confidence.

Option A is the package we can approve. It commits us to a firm volume over a longer term, and it takes your lead time into account, which is what a supplier with limited capacity needs from a reliable customer.

On the cost side:
Our cost estimate for Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM is EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).

On quality:
Your quality was 270 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70410@2026Q3).

On our price history:
Our orders of Mechanical seal 24 mm, SiC/carbon, EPDM with you were placed at EUR 29.89 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011517-10), EUR 29.89 on 2025-05-19 (po:4500012472-10), EUR 29.89 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013451-10) and EUR 29.89 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014436-10): the price has been unchanged.

Against that background, here is our proposal:
Our proposal: unit price EUR 28.50; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 42 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As the price is a step beyond your usual range, we would be glad if you would take Option A to your pricing committee. It gives Ravensteiner a binding volume and a steady customer for the full contract term.

I look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your cost estimate and price history, which permit a slight adjustment. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

Our offer stands at a price of €33.60 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months, and our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Which volume can you commit to?

Given our high capacity utilization, we can accept the volume of 23,400 units and the 24-month contract term, provided the lead time remains at 54 days. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: a price of €31.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

Option A below is the package we can approve. It commits us to the volume and the contract term you named, and it keeps the lead time in line with what your high capacity utilization requires.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 31.70; binding volume 23,400 units per year; contract term 24 months; lead time 56 days.
Binding volume in every option: 23,400 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. We would then have a settled arrangement that lets you plan with confidence and lets us rely on your supply.

Best regards

message.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We accept your proposal of EUR 31.70 per unit for a volume of 23,400 units per year over a 24-month contract term with a 56-day lead time. This arrangement aligns with our capacity requirements and concludes the negotiation. 

Our Angebot is a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. The offer is valid for 14 days. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
